name: Marimura Marin
source:
A girl the same age as the protagonist who attends the swimming school next to the Hospital.

She’s an idol-like girl with a lovely appearance. Her competitive swimsuit looks great on her slender figure.

Contrary to her cute appearance, she has an extremely violent personality and is a viciouss sadist. Her sadistic instincts react to the protagonist’s “bullyable” aura.

From their very first meeting, she strips him naked from the waist down and tramples on his penis. She despises his virginity and abuses him relentlessly, but does this beautiful girl even have any sexual experience herself?

[From [url=http://www.milkcrown.co.jp/hakudaku/dotei/dt_marine.html]official site[/url]]
